Tiwari and Vibhuti engage in heated disputes with their respective spouses. Later, Anita and Angoori exhibit highly unusual behaviour that leaves both men stunned.
Tiwari and Vibhuti grow anxious when their respective spouses fail to return home. Later, the Commissioner places both men in prison.
Anita and Angoori walk out of their marital homes to dine at a restaurant. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti orchestrate a scheme to create a rift between their wives.

Two bystanders attempt to forcefully smear vibrant pigments on Angoori. Consequently, Masterji arrives and swiftly thrashes them.
Tiwari and Vibhuti fantasise about celebrating Holi with Anita and Angoori. Later, the wives determine to check their husbands' loyalty.
Anita and Angoori issue stern warnings to their spouses via a phone call. However, the men disregard it as a practical joke.
Vibhuti and Tiwari serve laddoos laced with cannabis to Angoori and Anita. Consequently, the ladies consume the psychotropic confections.
Tiwari and Vibhuti slyly trick one another into eating spiked sweet treats. Later, the duo becomes inebriated while the colony residents celebrate Holi.

The host delivers an inspirational discourse, offering advice on life's major challenges before having a friendly discussion with prominent figures from various fields and sharing ideas and knowledge.
Pandit Hazari Prasad reveals that Manmohan and Angoori's marriage is invalid due to incorrect prayers. Seizing the moment, Vibhuti urges Angoori to avoid remarrying and pursues an affair.
Vibhuti skips his own bachelor's party for Manmohan and Happu, instead watching the live telecast of them dancing with Gulfam Kali alongside Anita and Angoori. Angoori later forgives Manmohan.
Vibhuti involves Manmohan in a card game, prompting Angoori to cancel their marriage. After revealing Vibhuti's actions, Manmohan remarries Angoori before the municipality seals his shop.
Minister Ram Sevak beats Vibhuti over a suspected affair, but they pretend to be friends publicly. While Anita rebukes Manmohan and Vibhuti, the neighbors flatter Vibhuti to reach the minister.
Manmohan becomes Vibhuti's servant to prevent his shop from closing. Later, Sulochana reveals her deception and Ram Sevak intervenes to save the business.
Manmohan and Vibhuti exchange insulting stories. After Happu shares that their electrician died, Anita warns Vibhuti. Later, a blackmailer forces Vibhuti to shove a cucumber in Manmohan's mouth.
Vibhuti apologises to Angoori for his erratic behaviour, claiming a medical condition causes him to lose control. Later, he is forced by a blackmailer to assault Tiwari.

Tiwari retaliates against Vibhuti's taunts by having him committed to a psychiatric facility. Meanwhile, Tiwari is forced by a blackmailer to mistreat Anita and humiliate the local residents.
Anita, Angoori, and the Commissioner catch Girdharilal, who admits to framing Vibhuti and Manmohan for revenge. The duo is freed while Girdharilal is institutionalized, but David tore his will.
Vibhuti rides a bicycle with Anita to Manmohan's envy. Saxena later deflates his tyre.

programs.d: Despite numerous attempts, Pushpa and Kajal are unable to conceive a child. To overcome this obstacle, they worship a divine goddess and fast to appease her.

Veer and Geet fall in love and decide to marry but Veer messes up his first impression on Geet's father, causing further obstacles.
Bringing the best in television.
A poor man falls for a female wrestler, but the situation becomes complicated for them after her father objects to their alliance and tries to set them apart.
Dhruv, who grew up an orphan, is in love with a woman who wishes to marry someone with a family. In order to fulfil his lover's wish, he hires two older individuals to pose as his parents.
Four animals from New York's Central Park Zoo find themselves stranded in the Madagascan jungle.
A seemingly corrupt petty contractor faces challenges from the local municipality, his family, his employees, as well as a former girlfriend and her family.
Sanjana is desperate to revive her hopeless relationship with Rahul. However, when the brooding and mysterious Shekhar comes along, her heart starts gravitating towards a new possibility.
A vegetable cutter has his life turned upside down when two strangers from China visit him and claim he is a reincarnation of a war hero.
A drama troupe flies to London for a performance. However, things take a tragic turn when three members of their team are falsely accused of murder.

programs.t: Once Upon a Time in Mumbai
programs.d: Sultan Mirza, a formidable smuggler, accepts a young troublemaker into his gang, unaware of the latter's true intentions in his quest for power.
Satya, a determined sister, reaches the foreign land where her brother is wrongfully imprisoned. She risks everything in a daring mission to break him free and save his life.
Karan travels to Italy along with Arjun, a former policeman, and Abhimanyu. He wants to find the gangster Baba Sikander and his brothers in order to bring them to justice for killing his father.
Dhoti, Topi and Suit Boot are more than happy to oblige when a group of alien kids come over to listen to adventure stories about their favourite Bal Ganesh.
Determined to help an underprivileged student, lawyer Tanvi Shukla takes on a high-stakes university scam in the city of Patna. However, her fight for justice puts her in a tricky situation.
Bajirao Singham, an honest police officer, encounters Babaji, a god-man with connections to high profile politicians, when he investigates the death of an officer from his team.
Shiva's life takes an unexpected turn when a child mistakes him for her father. Upon learning the truth, Shiva vows to change his ways for the better.
Three brothers are set to marry three sisters. However, a peek into the distant past reveals to one of the brothers that their brides have been mixed up in their current reincarnation.
Asif's belief in logic and science is shattered when the ghost possesses him and supernatural forces begin to take over his house.
Guna, a retired police officer, takes his daughter to the UK for much-needed medical treatment. However, a sudden turn of events leads to him getting imprisoned.
A retired jailer lives a peaceful life with his family. But when his son, who is a policeman, goes missing and is supposedly killed, he is forced to go back to his world of crime and find the killer.
Mimi, a small-time dancer from Rajasthan, decides to lend her womb to a wealthy American couple to fund her lifelong dream of becoming a Bollywood actress.
